REV-01 per-wave ICBM descent speed, integer byte of the "frames before update" period (SET UP ICBM SPEED, WICSPH). REV-01-vs-REV-03 delta (O-3): these WICSPH/WICSPL/ICBWAV difficulty tables are exactly where REV-01 (035820-01, the vendored tree) and REV-03 (035820-02, the widely-emulated "missile") diverge; this ships REV-01 per epic contract 3, and the exact REV-03 deltas require the REV-03 source, which is not in the vendored REV-01 tree.
8.8 fixed-point scale for the ICBM update period: ICSPDL is declared as a one-byte FRACTION of a frame, so its weight is 1/256 (period = ICSPDH + ICSPDL/256).
